Perform a variable-cell relaxation (vc-relax) plus a final self-consistent field (SCF) calculation for BiFeO3.
Use the LDA pseudopotentials PseudoDojo/SR_v0.4.1/LDA_standard/bi.upf, PseudoDojo/SR_v0.4.1/LDA_standard/fe.upf, and PseudoDojo/SR_v0.4.1/LDA_standard/o.upf.
Run the calculation as non-spin-polarized with nspin = 1.
Do not use Hubbard U, starting magnetization, or spin-orbit coupling.
Start from a primitive rhombohedral R3c BiFeO3 cell with 10 atoms per cell, using the standard experimental lattice parameters a = 5.63 Å and alpha = 59.35 degrees and the standard R3c internal atomic coordinates for Bi, Fe, and O.
Set ecutwfc = 80 Ry and ecutrho = 320 Ry.
Use an automatic Monkhorst-Pack k-point grid of 6x6x6 with half-shift offsets, corresponding to shift values 1 1 1.
For the vc-relax step, set calculation = 'vc-relax', etot_conv_thr = 1.0e-8, forc_conv_thr = 1.0e-7, and conv_thr = 1.0e-8.
Relax the cell vectors, cell angles, and all atomic positions without additional constraints.
After the vc-relax has converged, use the fully relaxed cell and atomic positions as the starting structure for the SCF run.
For the SCF step, set calculation = 'scf' and conv_thr = 1.0e-8, keeping the same pseudopotentials, ecutwfc, ecutrho, k-point grid, and non-spin-polarized treatment.
Report the fully relaxed structure, including the final cell parameters and atomic coordinates, and the final total SCF energy in Rydberg.
